nodes.label: docs workflow
nodes.rationale: Builds and deploys the Astro Starlight site under docs/ to GitHub Pages; build output is never committed, Pages consumes the workflow artifact. Requires a one-time Settings - Pages - Source: GitHub Actions, without which the deploy fails with Pages site not found. TypeDoc compiles ../src/ to extract JSDoc but src/ imports peer deps that live under the ROOT node_modules, so root deps install first and docs deps second - both frozen after #473; without the root install TypeDoc fails with TS2307 and TS2503 on every source file.

nodes.label: Deploy from main pushes only
nodes.rationale: main moves only when a release is cut, so published docs still track released versions. The release: [published] trigger was rejected because its runs execute on the TAG ref, which the github-pages environment protection refuses (only main may deploy) - that is how the v0.11.0 docs deploy failed. Not built on develop pushes or PRs because the build is slow; workflow_dispatch covers an out-of-band rebuild.

nodes.label: Mermaid SSR via headless Chromium
nodes.rationale: rehype-mermaid renders fenced mermaid blocks at build time by driving headless Chromium through Playwright; the npm package ships only JS bindings, so the browser binary plus Linux system libs are fetched separately with --with-deps. fetch-depth: 0 is also required so Starlight's lastUpdated can read Git history instead of reporting now on every page. Node 24 is installed because astro build's shebang spawns Node even under Bun.

nodes.label: Per-job Pages permissions split
nodes.rationale: pages: write and id-token: write are declared on the deploy job, never at workflow level (#621). Granted at the top they would also be minted for the job that installs the whole docs dependency tree and drives headless Chromium - the job most likely to execute someone else's code - even though upload-pages-artifact authenticates with the Actions runtime token instead. The deploy job has one step, no checkout, no dependencies, and deliberately no contents: read.
